//: Input to tools/gen-image.py. Every entry needs `claims` and `omits`.
This pack sets allowPhoto FALSE, and gen-image.py enforces it. A plate that
looks like a photograph reads as a RECORD, and there is no photographic
record of 1775 for it to be mistaken for. So every prompt here asks for an
oil painting, and the style suffix is the SAME on all of them -- the Phase 0
spike produced one oil painting and one piece of digital concept art from
two prompts written a minute apart, and mixed like that in one chapter it
Nothing here names a person, a regiment, a uniform facing or a flag. The
spike's redoubt came back as a pit because the model does not know what a
redoubt is, and its prettier second attempt had a STEAMBOAT in an
eighteenth-century river. Distance, weather and backs of heads are what it
renders well and are also what the evidence supports. Where a detail is
unknown, it is composed out of frame and said so in `omits`.

vei-ved-daggry.prompt: an empty country road at first light winding between low dry-stone walls and bare trees, heavy dew, mist lying in the fields either side, no people, no buildings, cold spring morning
vei-ved-daggry.style: muted historical oil painting on canvas, restrained palette, soft edges
vei-ved-daggry.claims: An empty country road between stone walls at dawn in early spring, the kind of ground the day was fought over.
vei-ved-daggry.omits: Not an identified road or place. No people, so nothing is claimed about who was on it or when.

kolonne-paa-avstand.prompt: a long column of soldiers in dark coats marching away along a road seen from a hillside far above, the figures small enough that no faces or uniform detail can be made out, dust rising, open farmland, early morning light
kolonne-paa-avstand.style: muted historical oil painting on canvas, restrained palette, soft edges
kolonne-paa-avstand.claims: A column of troops on a road, seen from far enough away that it reads as a body of men rather than as individuals.
kolonne-paa-avstand.omits: No uniform facing, regiment, flag or face is visible, and none is claimed. The distance is deliberate: the detail is not known.

stein-gjerde-roykskyer.prompt: powder smoke drifting low across a field behind a dry-stone wall, bare April trees beyond, a few indistinct dark figures crouched behind the wall seen from behind, grey overcast light
stein-gjerde-roykskyer.style: muted historical oil painting on canvas, restrained palette, soft edges
stein-gjerde-roykskyer.claims: Powder smoke over a field and a stone wall, with figures using the wall as cover.
stein-gjerde-roykskyer.omits: Seen from behind and through smoke: no faces, no uniforms, no weapons in detail. Not a depiction of any identified engagement.

havn-og-master.prompt: a colonial harbour at dusk with the bare masts and rigging of many anchored ships crowding the waterfront, low wooden warehouses along the quay, still water, lamps just being lit
havn-og-master.style: muted historical oil painting on canvas, restrained palette, soft edges
havn-og-master.claims: A crowded eighteenth-century harbour of masts and warehouses at dusk.
havn-og-master.omits: Not an identified port, ship or company. No name or sign is legible anywhere in the frame.

leir-om-natten.prompt: a field encampment at night, rows of pale canvas tents lit from within, a few low campfires, dark treeline behind, cold mist across the ground, distant figures as silhouettes only
leir-om-natten.style: muted historical oil painting on canvas, restrained palette, soft edges
leir-om-natten.claims: A canvas encampment at night, the ordinary condition of an army in the field.
leir-om-natten.omits: No standard, unit or person is identifiable. Not a depiction of any particular camp.

baater-over-vannet.prompt: several open rowing boats crossing dark still water at night, seen from the shore, muffled oars, crowded low silhouettes aboard, a faint line of land on the far side, moonlight behind cloud
baater-over-vannet.style: muted historical oil painting on canvas, restrained palette, soft edges

title.en: Across the water in the dark

baater-over-vannet.claims: Open boats crossing water at night with men aboard, the ordinary way a river was crossed unseen.
baater-over-vannet.omits: Silhouettes only. No face, uniform or boat type is identified, and this is not a depiction of a named crossing.

gresskledd-bakke.prompt: a bare grassy hillside rising above a wide harbour, low earth banks freshly turned near the crest, the town and its water far below and behind, hazy summer morning light, no figures in the foreground
gresskledd-bakke.style: muted historical oil painting on canvas, restrained palette, soft edges
gresskledd-bakke.claims: A grassy hill above a harbour with freshly turned earth banks near its top.
gresskledd-bakke.omits: Not an identified hill or town, and the earthwork is generic. No troops are shown, so nothing is claimed about who held it.

vinterveien-hjem.prompt: a rutted muddy road in late afternoon with long shadows, a scatter of small dark figures walking away in ones and twos far ahead, bare hedgerows, a cold clear sky, no buildings
vinterveien-hjem.style: muted historical oil painting on canvas, restrained palette, soft edges
vinterveien-hjem.claims: A rutted road at the end of a day with a few figures walking away in the distance.
vinterveien-hjem.omits: The figures are too distant to identify as anything in particular. Not a depiction of a named retreat or march.
